derivation: patrial from a place corresponding in name (but not identical) with H5279 (נַעֲמָה);
def: a Naamathite, or inhabitant of Naamah

occurrences.text: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place; Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite: for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.
Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the Lord commanded them: the Lord also accepted Job.
